why_seated: THE CATILINE CONSPIRACY, at the author's word ("and the catiline conspiracy", 2026-11-20 18:40). The conspiracy of 63 BCE in its own witnesses: Sallust's monograph; Cicero's four speeches against Catiline, the Pro Murena delivered in the same weeks, and the Pro Sulla for P. Sulla, the dictator's nephew, accused of complicity; Plutarch's Cicero, Cato the Younger and Caesar for the debate on the conspirators. Companion to Plutarch's Sulla (EA-CORPORA-13/01).

research.for: the one-corpus premise (Plato, Aristotle and Theophrastus as one corpus in two transmission streams) and the relations it was read against: the impiety charges, the Macedonian patronage of the school, the Alexander traditions of Judaea, and the comic and tragic stage the King Archon administered
